title: Let me cook.
transcript: Yo, are you okay, buddy? I did it. What did you do? I entered a new tournament on the aisle of white. Wait, wait. Didn't you just lose a bunch of tournaments in Amsterdam and in Rome? That's not all. Don't tell me. I've entered the master section. No, it can't be. You're a fool. >> You are the fool. Don't you understand? >> But this is the only way I can improve. I am not going to play to win but to learn. >> They are going to destroy you. >> For how can David beat Goliath if he doesn't defeat his fear first. >> I mean I guess but I am going to play in the tournament and I expect to lose every single game. You don't understand. I am going to get humiliated in front of thousands of people only for the sake of learning, growing, becoming stronger and better. And one day I am going to play in one of these tournaments and I am actually going to win it.
